<!-- Set notebook options -->
```{r knitr_options}
#| context: setup
#| include: false
library(knitr)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
    results=FALSE,
    message=FALSE,
    warning=FALSE,
    # dev=c('png', 'pdf', 'svg'),
    dev=c('png'),
    dpi=300
)
```
<!-- Load dependencies -->
```{r load_basic_dependencies}
#| context: setup
#| include: false
library(here)
source(here('scripts', 'basic.imports.R'))
source(here('scripts', 'utils.decorate.R'))
source(here('scripts', 'utils.plot.R'))
```
